carouselChartTitle: AI编排平台4周做到月入2万，他的GTM秘诀
author: 阿星
content:
**20年GTM经验，他把SDR工作完全自动化了**

Santanu Dasgupta做了20年SaaS公司的go-to-market，横跨美国、欧洲、印度——从湾区的Oracle mobile database spinout做developer开始，后来转入GTM和growth。

之后在Gartner Consulting和Tata Consultancy Services和startups、enterprises合作scale demand generation和revenue，亲眼看到GTM still depends on多少manual work、fragmented tools、agency-heavy execution。

这个insight led him to start AI orchestration product叫Meerkats.ai。

Essentially在software里build digital growth agency。**Meerkats替代SDRs、marketers、agencies通常处理的重复性工作**——capturing和enriching relationship data、generating leads、running campaigns、following up——全部来自simple chat interface。

Startups' GTM teams选择Meerkats.ai而不是Claude Managed Agents或OpenAI Agent Harness等平台，因为他们想要model choice的flexibility（bring cheapest model appropriate for task）。Also，可能没有in-house talent build in Agent Harness，所以offload entire task给Meerkats作为"Service as a Software"或甚至outcome-based service。

平台4周前launch，现在月入3000+美元（约2万人民币）。

To keep lights on，从Chicago大学Polsky Center拿了funding作为Alumni New Venture Challenge的一部分。

Also offered Agency services作为platform的一部分来fund operations。

还从Azure、OpenAI、Anthropic拿了generous credits抵model costs。

## 二、

Build V1：

- Spreadsheet UI查看lead lists和enrichment platform
- Infrastructure scale enrichments到50K+ rows under 30分钟
- Integrations with third-party servers，enable dynamic code execution based on user requirements
- Autonomous Agents with full manus-like capabilities，including memory management、sandbox code execution、evals、tool selection、Skills.md、files for knowledge base

Helped create end-to-end native AI platform。整个setup有时叫Agent Harness，enable Agents work reliably at scale across multiple workflows。这些systems可以plan和execute open-ended tasks、pick right tools和models for task、handle execution errors、request human attention when required。

Initial product leveraged AI models like Claude、Gemini、Codex，agentic frameworks such as Claude Skills SDK、Codex、LangChain、Crew AI、AutoGen、Google Cloud Platform（GCP）。也inspired by OpenClaw capabilities。

Rest of stack：
- Supabase
- Google Cloud Platform for scaling
- Fly.io for sandbox code execution
- React frontend和Node.js server
- MCP servers和CLI endpoints in GCP containers

选择Supabase因为Row Level Security feature，以及built-in authentication、real-time updates、MCP server hosting等powerful features。Feel much more modern than Mongo，hence migrated。

## 三、

Business model基于consumption，factoring in enrichments数量、LLM执行的actions、task complexity。

Aim make it very easy start growth flow，通常在top of funnel，然后help agencies或businesses with other revenue-impacting workflows。

Also seeing demand from customers for agencies package service as "Outcome-as-a-service"——客户pay agency for particular outcome或task completed——similar to如果hired VA，但Agent completes task。

三个增长渠道：

1. Combine cold和targeted outreach to agencies in network。Specifically target run marketing campaigns for clients without using AI的agencies。

2. Run educational events online和offline educate agencies on how best leverage AI Agents for revenue。

3. Attract users through LinkedIn posts。

如果重来，会做更多content marketing，up front build bigger audiences。

## 四、

最大挑战是AI capabilities发展多rapidly——competitive landscape和differentiation completely changed。

Fortunately，made right architectural choices，releasing right product at right time。

Key lesson：**Navigating rapid tech changes对startups tough，但对incumbents tougher。** Startups和indie hackers应该view this disruption as opportunity，not threat。

他的情况，过去10年automation technology相对稳定，players like Make.com、n8n、Zapier。这个stack现在considered legacy，有了AI orchestration、new models、orchestration frameworks。

## 五、

建议：

**Understand agentic behavior：** Focus on handle processes end-to-end的agents，not just AI wrappers。

**Identify customer problems where AI solutions can drive revenue和cut costs。**

**Find repetitive、manually done的tasks——convert to Agents。** Start with one high-value、painful、directly impacts revenue或customer experience的task。Use as wedge rapidly expand to other tasks。

## 写在最后

Santanu的故事告诉我们——

**20年行业经验是unfair advantage。**他懂GTM的pain points，因为lived it。

他的core insight：**Don't just build AI wrappers。Build end-to-end agents that handle processes。**

还有,start with one high-value task as wedge，then expand。

技术栈选择也很strategic——Supabase for modern features，Fly.io for sandbox execution，GCP for scale。

最重要的是，**view rapid AI development as opportunity，not threat。** Incumbents更难adapt。

*原文来自Indie Hackers，由AI翻译并改写*
